room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day; associated medical expenses (except pharmacy, implants, diagnostics) proportionally limited if higher room chosen

icu.note: ICU/Therapeutic Unit capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.display: 35% if treated in Zone A city
copayment.note: 35% co-pay applies when insured takes treatment in a Zone A city (major metros and large cities listed in policy)

sub_limits.display: Cataract, hernia, knee/hip, cancer, piles, hysterectomy, etc. capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 5% SI max ₹15k; Piles/Fistula/Tonsillitis/Sinusitis: 8% SI max ₹25k; BPH/Hernia: 8% SI max ₹30k; Knee/Hip/Cancer/Renal failure: 30% SI max ₹1L; Appendicitis/Gallbladder/Hysterectomy: 10% SI max ₹25k; Modern treatments: 50% SI; Domiciliary: 20% SI

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability/migration norms

specific_disease_waiting.note: 12 months: Tonsillitis/Adenoids, Gastric/Duodenal Ulcer, Cysts/Nodules/Polyps, Breast lumps; 24 months: Cataract, BPH, Hysterectomy, Hernia, Hydrocele, Fistula, Piles, Sinusitis, Cholelithiasis, Spondylosis, Disc Prolapse, Knee/Joint/Hip replacement, Osteoarthritis, Varicose Veins

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Code Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: Policy mentions cumulative bonus in context of grace period and portability but does not define the rate or maximum in the wording provided

restoration.note: Sum insured can be reinstated after a claim but reinstatement premium is deducted from the claim amount; not available for chronic diseases (cancer, CABG, stroke, etc.) or domiciliary hospitalisation; reinstated SI not available for same illness relapse within 45 days

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days preceding hospitalisation

post_hosp.display: 30 days, up to 7% of hosp expenses, max ₹7,500
post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation limited to 7% of hospitalisation expenses (excl. room rent) up to ₹7,500 within 30 days of discharge

day_care.note: Extensive list of day care procedures in Annexure B; list is dynamic

domiciliary.note: Covered when patient cannot be moved to hospital or no room available; 12 specific diseases excluded from domiciliary cover (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.)

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation including pre/post hospitalisation covered in AYUSH Hospitals or AYUSH Day Care Centres

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered within insured's sub-limits and SI; no ambulance, pre/post hosp or daily allowance for donor

ambulance.note: Road ambulance charges limited to ₹750 or actual, whichever is less, per claim

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered up to 50% of Sum Insured

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-payable consumables in Annexure A List I (gloves, masks, etc.); no optional rider mentioned

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause restricts all treatment to India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to original SI; enhanced SI has fresh 60-month period

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly instalments; 30 days for other instalments and renewal; coverage not available during grace period for renewal

free_look.note: Applicable only at inception, not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: Apply at least 30 days before renewal; accrued waiting period credits and bonus transferred

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, adventure sports (non-professional too), acupuncture/acupressure, intra-articular injections, OPD treatment, refractive error <7.5D, Cytotron/EECP/Chelation therapy, Zone A 35% copay

optional_riders.note: Policy references 'Optional Extension' in definitions but no specific riders are described in the wording
